skills.source: The Regional Medical Operations Coordination Center (RMOCC) Data Analyst (East/West Liaison) supports the collection, validation, analysis, and communication of regional healthcare and EMS data. The East regional liaison data analyst will coordinate with the University of Kentucky (UK) team, while the West regional liaison data analyst will coordinate with the University of Louisville (UofL) in line with a consistent RMOCC operating model. The data analyst will translate operational data into timely, decision-relevant information for RMOCC leadership and regional partners, working closely with the counterpart analyst to align data practices across regions, identify capacity and patient-flow trends, support dashboards and recurring reports, and improve data quality and usability. The analyst will also support the monitoring, analysis, and reporting of Pulsara utilization and transfer coordination data, helping identify opportunities to improve interfacility communication, patent movement, and regional resource coordination. During RMOCC activations or surge events, the analyst may provide data and situational awareness support within the established command and escalation structure.

unparsed.source: As a Full Stack Engineer, you'll work on our enterprise AI SaaS product https://joinpogo.ai/ and own meaningful parts of the product end-to-end. This is a hands-on role with real responsibility. Specifically, you will:
Build and own user-facing product features from idea to production
Work closely with engineering, product, and design to plan, architect, and ship features
You'll also partner with functional leaders across the organization (i.e., GTM, finance, customer support) to design and build internal tools to streamline operations and eliminate manual workflows.
You have strong product and design taste and a clear sense of what “good” looks like
You take ownership and are comfortable driving an entire part of a product
You manage your own time and priorities well
You're happy moving across frontend and backend when needed
You communicate clearly and work well with others, especially when things are ambiguous
You've built and maintained production systems used by real users
You're comfortable learning new tools and building things from scratch
Bonus:
Experience at early-stage startups or building your own products
Have heard of Animations.Dev http://Animations.Dev, Devouring Details https://devouringdetails.com/, or InterfaceCraft https://www.interfacecraft.dev/
WHY YOU MIGHT BE EXCITED ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY 🙌
Ship real products that get real usage, from customer-facing features to internal tools
Work cross-functionally. Partner with product, design, ops, GTM, data, and CS
Use the latest tech. Build with the latest coding tools and infrastructure
Move fast. Ship quickly and get rapid feedback from real users and teammates
WHY YOU MIGHT NOT BE EXCITED ABOUT US 👎

Priorities may shift quickly. Oftentimes, we're tackling very ambiguous problems that don't have clear-cut answers. While we make calculated bets, we have a strong culture of experimentation and we'll pivot as necessary based on what we're seeing in the data and what we're hearing from our users.

At times, you'll need to build things in a day: we live and breathe a value called “Calculated Speed”, which involves iterating and shipping weekly, rather than spending months going through complex processes or lengthy builds. Our engineers are some of the best in the world, which means anything you design today may be shipped next week.

We don't have structured management (yet!). We don't have the management overhead to provide direction every step of the way and we're looking for someone that gets energized by being able to run with things.

You can identify the core idea inside a method, understand the assumptions that make it work, determine whether those assumptions hold in your setting, and adapt the idea into a working prototype.

Research Judgment: You can distinguish a difficult engineering problem from a research problem, design experiments that isolate the important variable, and abandon an elegant approach when the evidence suggests a simpler method works better.

Applied Foundation Model Systems: Hands-on experience building reliable systems with modern language or multimodal models, including retrieval, structured generation, evaluation, grounding, and model adaptation. Are comfortable moving between theory and reality: papers, hypotheses, experiments, raw traces, screen recordings, production failures, and systems that must work at organizational scale.

Want to work with a small, unusually ambitious team where research judgment and engineering execution are inseparable, and where your ideas can shape the architecture of an entirely new kind of system.

unparsed.source: Strong software engineering background with experience building and maintaining production applications, services, or internal platforms.
Strong product mindset with the ability to translate ambiguous business problems into practical technical solutions.

Experience building internal AI platforms or enterprise AI automation solutions.

Experience working in a fast growing technology company where speed, ownership, and adaptability are essential.

You'll help make AI a practical and valuable part of how Phantom operates. Success means delivering solutions that teams actively use, reducing manual work, accelerating execution, and creating a scalable foundation for continued AI adoption.
You'll have the opportunity to own projects from concept through production, influence our internal AI strategy, and help define how we leverage AI across the organization.
Why Work With Us

Phantom's journey to becoming a global trading app began with making crypto easier to use. Today, we're building on that foundation to help people discover the markets that matter, make informed financial moves, and safely store or spend their money worldwide. Joining Phantom means helping shape that next chapter: building products that bring the freedom of open markets to more people.
Build for global impact: Create products used by tens of millions of people, making innovative financial markets more accessible to users around the world.
Make complexity feel simple: Solve meaningful challenges across design, engineering, and user experience to make discovering markets and managing money seamless.
Put users in control: Help build a future where people have greater freedom over their assets and financial decisions, with security and self-custody at the foundation.
